values.note: Small sites, most built for tents or vans; RVs and trailers over 35 ft not allowed. Sites 7-12 are tent-only/walk-to and 8 is the group site. Per-site maximums of 23 ft or more: 2-6, 13-16, 18, 19 and 21-24 (35 ft at 4, 5, 6, 14 and 19); sites 1, 17 and 20 are 20-22 ft. Pull-throughs at 14 (35 ft) and 20 (20 ft).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10341389 ('This 24-site campground including 1 Group Site'; 'Most sites are designed for tent or van camping'; 'Campsites 7-12 are Tent Only, campsites 14 and 20 are Pull-Throughs, Sites 4, 5, 14, 19, 20 and 21 are large enough for RV’s and Trailers up to 35’'; notice 'RV’s and Trailers longer than 35’ are not allowed at Turtle Rock Campground.') + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:10341389 (per-site Max Vehicle Length 15-35; 14 and 20 Pull-through), read 2026-10-28

values.note: One double vault toilet. No drinking water or trash service: bring water, pack out trash, bring firewood.

values.note: $20 a standard site, $40 the group site; the same for 2026 and 2027.

values.note: Sites 5-21 reservable on recreation.gov 3 months ahead; an unreserved one can be taken first come for one night at the pay station. Sites 1-4 and 22-24 are first come, first served (pay at the station on arrival).

note: BLM campground 3.5 miles north of Buena Vista in the Fourmile Recreation Area, ~8,300 ft, in pinyon-juniper at the base of the Turtle Rock granite (popular with climbers), with views of the Collegiate Peaks. Many sites are short, so pick one listed at 23 ft or more. Hiking, mountain-bike and OHV trails from camp. From Buena Vista: E Arkansas St, CR 371 2.2 mi, CR 375 0.8 mi. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov (10341389) description, notices, rates and per-site catalog: confirmed 24 sites (1 group), max 35 ft, no hookups/water/trash, vault toilet, $20 (2026 and 2027), 14-night limit, open Mar 1 - Nov 30; added pull-throughs, per-site lengths, 3-month window, reservable sites 5-21 vs FCFS 1-4/22-24, reservation season. Phone confirmed (Royal Gorge FO). No BLM page exists. Note cleaned of field facts.

Main St., Canon City (BLM office page 'Phone: 719-269-8500'); recreation.gov facility phone is the same number and the facility email is BLM_CO_RG_VisitorInfo@blm.gov. Fourmile is in the Royal Gorge FO; not a separate Arkansas Headwaters office number.

Website: recreation.gov is the only agency page. https://www.blm.gov/visit/turtle-rock-campground returns 'Sorry, the content you are looking for is not published or has moved' and https://www.blm.gov/visit/fourmile-recreation-area 'Page Not Found' (both read 2026-10-28 in a browser). Keep the recreation.gov link.

Rig length: the agency singles this campground out ('The campsites at Turtle Rock Campground are small'; 'Most sites are designed for tent or van camping'; 'Large RVs and travel trailers over 35 feet are not recommended'; notice 'RV’s and Trailers longer than 35’ are not allowed'), but it also states 'Sites 4, 5, 14, 19, 20 and 21 are large enough for RV’s and Trailers up to 35’' and the catalog lists 15 RV-capable sites at 24-35 ft. A 23-ft rig fits; no criteria problem. (The catalog gives site 20, a pull-through, only 20 ft, contradicting its listing among the 35-ft sites.)

Road: recreation.gov gives only directions ('turn left onto County Road 371, in 2.2 miles turn right onto County Road 375, in .8 miles turn left into the Turtle Rock Campground entrance'); no surface, grade, 4WD or closure wording, and no notice of a closure. No BLM page to check for alerts.
Pin 38.88194,-106.14482 (= recreation.gov facility point) is ~100 m east of the per-site centroid (38.88222,-106.14589) and 25 m from the nearest site (1). OK.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: on imagery the Arkansas River runs in its canyon ~250 m SW of the sites, below the Turtle Rock outcrops that stand between the campground and the river. The 'view of the Arkansas River below' in the description is from the rock, not the sites.
